type Item = { tag?: "a" } & { tag?: "b" } & { tag: "c" | undefined };
const item: Item = { tag: undefined };
item.tag = undefined;
console.log(item.tag);

class Data {
  get value(): string | undefined { return undefined; }
  set value(value: string | number | undefined) { console.log(value); }
}
const data: Data & { value?: string } = new Data();
data.value = undefined;
data.value = "a";
